assumptions.governing_form: a CSV row is judged only by rules of the form(s) whose reporting year (Start Here!B5) equals the row's YEAR; a row whose YEAR has no form is not checked; a (column, year) on which same-year forms disagree is reported and judges no row
assumptions.csv_vocabulary: vocabulary='csv' translates TENURE list items R->Renter, O->Owner, treats INFILL_UNITS '0' as blank (measured 2026-11-18 from 2,551 matched workbook/CSV rows); vocabulary='form' applies the form's own codes
assumptions.demolition_columns_zero: HCD's published CSV shows '0' in DEM_OR_DES_UNITS and DEM_DES_UNITS_OWN_RENT in every complete matched row where the form had an entry (measured 2026-11-18: 43/43, 31/31), while rows the repair script rebuilds from the workbooks carry the form's own values ('Demolished'/'Destroyed'; 'O'/'R'). Author's ruling 2026-11-18: that state is accepted and modelled; vocabulary='csv' allows the form rule's items plus '0' on those two columns, anything else is a violation
assumptions.date_mapping: A2_5_Date/A2_8_Date/A2_10_Date -> ENT_APPROVE_DT1/BP_ISSUE_DT1/CO_ISSUE_DT1 in the validator only; workbook datetimes render as YYYY-MM-DD
assumptions.date_formats: whitelist %Y-%m-%d, %m/%d/%Y, %Y/%m/%d, %m/%d/%y; pure-integer values treated as Excel serials
assumptions.data_area: rows data_start..data_end; data_start follows the 'Start Data Entry Below' sentinel, data_end is the start row of the template's overflow block (the most common start row of ranges running to the sheet's last row) minus one; rules on header-less columns are listed as unenforced
assumptions.first_rule_wins: Excel applies the first rule in file order where rules overlap; a later rule is shadowed (unenforced) only when earlier rules cover all its data-area rows; a partial overlap is kept with partial_overlap=true; CSV rows are not row-scoped, so both rules count as two distinct rules for one column and year, are listed by form_disagreements and judge no CSV row (no shipped template has one)
assumptions.multi_select: list rules on columns whose Worksheet_Change macro joins picks check each item; items split on ',' or ';' (macro writes ', '; the published CSV uses ';' in some columns, e.g. DR_TYPE, APPROVE_SB35)
assumptions.unenforced_listing: template strips, overflow rows, shadowed rules, header-less columns, unmapped columns, unsupported operators, drifted custom formulas and unresolved references are listed in 'unenforced', not dropped; rule types other than list, whole, decimal, date and custom (e.g. textLength, time) would be counted as enforced but are not evaluated; no shipped template has one
assumptions.custom_xlow: the known 2023+ A2_13_xLow formula is enforced: blank passes, non-numeric fails, otherwise a violation iff the value exceeds ALL THREE pair sums; blank/text comparator cells count as 0 (Excel SUM semantics); any other custom formula is drift and stays unenforced
